name: Phoebe Theodorakis
original_name: フェーベ・テオドラキス
source:
One of XFJ Project’s dedicated operators. The youngest of the operators, but she has actual combat experience. She tries to act like an adult, but sometimes she fails. Interested in Japan, and always looking for a chance to talk to Yui.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
